description: This source file defines the class ConfigReader, which provides methods to load, read, and modify configuration properties from a PHP file. It manages a cache of properties for efficiency and supports dynamic configuration updates.

classes.name: ConfigReader
classes.description: A class for managing configuration properties by loading from a PHP file, allowing retrieval and setting of config values, with caching support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ConfigReader object and loads configuration from the specified file path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads configuration properties from a specified PHP file, optionally forcing reload and utilizing caching.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets a configuration key to a specified value and updates the cache.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified configuration key.
